webhooks.detail: Database Webhooks fire on table INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (HTTP POST/GET via pg_net). Platform Webhooks (org/project events via Management API) are early-access only.

evidence.quote: Database Webhooks allow you to send real-time data from your database to another system whenever a table event occurs.

sandbox.detail: Free Plan includes two free projects, usable for testing integrations. Free projects pause after 1 week of inactivity.

evidence.quote: You can create two projects, one for development and one for production — the Free Plan includes two free projects.

rate_limits.summary: Management API: 120 requests/min per user, per project or org, per endpoint; 429 when exceeded. Some analytics endpoints 30/min.

evidence.quote: Rate limits are applied to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage of the Management API.
Some libraries are officially supported, and some are contributed by the community.
